title: Same force, different mass
action: A timed force pulse gives the familiar points different accelerations. Coast after the pulse; compare 1, 2 and 4 kg.
learn: Force, mass, acceleration; ending a force preserves velocity.

title: The drain becomes an orbit
action: Release the point into a radial field, then add a sideways component. A cube can join it; the path is integrated, not animated.

title: Slide, roll or tip?
action: Release a rotation-locked sphere, a free sphere and a cube on three equal slopes. Compare contact, rolling and sticking.

title: Where the pipe lets go
action: Send the point through a transparent, open curved channel. Predict where it leaves; the channel stops but motion and gravity continue.
learn: Contact redirects velocity; tangent and ballistic departure.

title: The belt keeps going
action: Feed twelve cubes against a closed receiver. Open the gate and see which boxes still make it. Spilled boxes remain available.
learn: Contact motion, input/output rate, accumulated backlog.

title: It caught the doorstop
action: Attract the chosen point, then widen the filter to include the doorstop. The hinged door keeps trying to close.

title: Three bodies, two beginnings
action: Release two planar trios with one small velocity difference. Compare their paths with equal opposite forces and softened near contact.
learn: Pairwise force sums, initial conditions, limits of prediction.

title: Remove one support
action: Let a loaded table settle. Pull the marked foot and keep the collapse, or rebuild it by hand.
learn: Support, centre of mass, contact and structural dependence.

title: One push, two directions
action: Send the point into a little bowling formation. Compare a braced launch cart with a free one; retain the knocked blocks.

title: The lever lets go
action: Release a point from a hinged cup driven by a short torque pulse. Its flight comes from contact with the arm.
learn: Torque, hinge constraint, release and trajectory.
